# FalaAI API - PHP SDK

> Official PHP SDK for the FalaAI API - AI-powered call transcription (speech-to-text), conversation diagnostics, and compliance/risk auditing.

## Links
- Documentation: https://actiontecbr.github.io/falaai-api-php/
- Repository: https://github.com/ActionTecBr/falaai-api-php
- Package (Packagist): https://packagist.org/packages/actiontecbr/falaai-api
- OpenAPI contract: https://api01-falaai.action.tec.br/openapi.json
- Platform: https://falaai.action.tec.br/api

## Endpoints
- POST /v1/audio/transcriptions - transcribe a call (audio to text)
- POST /v1/analyze/diagnostic - conversation diagnosis
- POST /v1/analyze/riskAudit - compliance / risk audit
- POST /v1/whatsapp/extractConversations - extract and segment WhatsApp conversations from an export
- GET /v1/health - health check
- GET /api/version - API version
